project_info.theme: Soft intimate lipstick portrait for YSL Loveshine
project_info.color_palette: Blush pink, nude rose, black hair, warm beige skin, silver chrome

main_subject.detail: A dark-haired female model reclines on blush pink bedding and lightly touches a pale pink YSL lipstick to her lower lip. Her hand with black nail polish holds the lipstick, and the frame is a tight vertical beauty crop showing face, lips, hand, and soft pink textile.
main_subject.style: Luxury beauty endorsement portrait, intimate soft-glam campaign photography, feminine product-on-lips close-up

items: Top Left: Model's dark hair and warm skin against soft pink bedding
Top Right: Direct gaze with polished brows and lashes in a close beauty crop
Bottom Left: Bent arm and shoulder creating a soft framing shape
Bottom Right: Hand with black nail polish holding a pale pink YSL lipstick against the lower lip
Center/Background: Close portrait of the model resting on blush pink fabric with nude-rose lipstick applied

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Creamy skin glow, gentle textile softness, subtle chrome highlights, intimate feminine warmth

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality vertical luxury beauty campaign portrait for YSL. Centerpiece is a dark-haired female model reclining on blush pink bedding, lightly touching a pale pink YSL lipstick to her lower lip while holding it with a hand showing black nail polish. Keep a tight intimate crop on the face, lips, hand, and soft pink fabric. Technical style: photoreal beauty campaign photography, soft romantic beauty lighting, creamy skin glow and subtle chrome highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
